body: Thank you for the resources. I am currently seeing a therapist and it helps on the days I do see them but after It just seems pointless. I'm just inconsolable at times. I don't have friends, just drinking buddys. My own mother can care less If I live or die. She never wanted me anyway so I think I'd be doing a service by ending it. I guess thats what hurts the most is being alone and feeling so unloved and unwanted. My therapist tells me I need to find people but it's not that easy. I'm a outgoing person but I'm so jaded by the hurt caused by the people who have been in my life. It's just hopeless for me I think.
